story_note: The "story" kind is a storytelling carousel for the feed (4:5, 1080x1350), NOT an Instagram Story. It is not 9:16.
allocation_note: Default batch = 20 network-posts, exactly the Free plan monthly cap. The cap is per calendar month and per network post, so a 30-day batch that spans two months gets two budgets. inventory.py budget <YYYY-MM> counts what is already planned.

schedule.note: Slots follow Metricool benchmark data (weekday late-morning for Facebook, mid-afternoon for YouTube). Instagram has no account history yet; revisit after 30 days of analytics.

portfolio.never_imply: that any of them was commissioned by a real client

ground_mix.status: starting hypothesis, adjust on performance; not a limit

content_rules.third_party_analysis: publicly accessible, verifiable, fair, sourced with URL and capture date; no invented performance data; never imply a company hired us
content_rules.voiceover: none until the owner approves a voice after listening to the test

volume.not_a_ceiling: 20 pieces is the first test only; Metricool Starter is under consideration (owner decision pending)

batch_default_note: Default 10-piece batch is education-first: 7 education, 2 demonstration, 1 story (70/20/10). Formats: 3 reels, 3 carousels, 1 showcase, 2 graphics, 1 story carousel. Network allocation unchanged: 20 network-posts.
